Introduction

Choosing your first tarot deck is an exciting and personal experience, but with so many options available, it can also feel overwhelming. Whether you’re drawn to tarot for self-reflection, spiritual growth, or divination, finding the right deck is key to developing a strong connection with your readings. In this guide, we’ll walk you through the process of selecting your first tarot deck, what to consider, and how to begin your journey with confidence.

Understanding Tarot Decks

What is a Tarot Deck?

A tarot deck is a collection of 78 cards divided into the Major Arcana (22 cards) and the Minor Arcana (56 cards). Each card carries symbolic imagery and meanings that can be interpreted intuitively or studied in depth.

Different Types of Tarot Decks

While the Rider-Waite-Smith (RWS) deck is the most well-known and widely used, there are many other types of tarot decks available, such as:

  • Thoth Tarot – Rich in esoteric symbolism, ideal for deep spiritual exploration.
  • Marseille Tarot – A historical deck with traditional imagery, often used for classical interpretations.
  • Modern & Themed Decks – These include decks based on pop culture, animals, mythology, and more, offering a fresh take on traditional tarot.

Factors to Consider When Choosing Your First Tarot Deck

1. Go with Your Intuition

The most important factor in choosing a first tarot deck is how it makes you feel. Look at different decks and pay attention to which ones you feel drawn to—your intuition will guide you to the right choice.

2. Consider the Artwork

Tarot is a visual tool, so the imagery of your deck should resonate with you. Ask yourself:

  • Do I connect with the colors, illustrations, and symbols?
  • Does the artwork inspire my intuition?

3. Begin with a Beginner-Friendly Deck

Some decks are more suited for beginners due to their clear symbolism and easy-to-understand imagery. The Rider-Waite-Smith deck is highly recommended because:

  • It has rich yet straightforward symbolism.
  • Many tarot books and tarot tips are based on it.
  • It’s widely available and easy to learn from.

4. Look at the Guidebook

A well-written guidebook can be invaluable for beginners. Some decks come with detailed books that provide card meanings, spreads, and interpretations, making them easier to learn.

5. Size and Feel of the Cards

Tarot decks come in different sizes—some are large with intricate details, while others are compact and easy to shuffle. If you have smaller hands, a standard or mini deck might be more comfortable to use.

6. Traditional vs. Themed Decks

If you’re a beginner, a traditional tarot deck might be easier to learn from before exploring more artistic or themed variations. However, if a specific theme deeply resonates with you (e.g., astrology, animals, or fantasy), it can enhance your personal connection with the deck.

Where to Buy Your First Tarot Deck

You can purchase tarot decks online, in metaphysical stores, or at bookstores. Some things to keep in mind:

  • Buying in Person: This allows you to feel the deck in your hands and see the artwork up close.
  • Online Shopping: Read reviews and look at sample images of the cards before purchasing.
  • Gift vs. Self-Purchase: There’s a myth that your first tarot deck must be gifted, but this isn’t true—you can absolutely buy your own!

Bonding with Your Tarot Deck

Once you have your deck, spend some time getting to know it:

  • Flip through the cards to familiarize yourself with the imagery.
  • Shuffle and handle them to create a personal energetic connection.
  • Do a simple one-card pull each day to start learning meanings intuitively.
  • Use a tarot journal to document your readings and insights.

Tricks for Learning Tarot

Learning tarot takes time, patience, and practice. Here are a few tricks for learning tarot that can help you build confidence:

  • Pull a daily card and reflect on its meaning.
  • Practice with simple spreads (like a three-card spread).
  • Use flashcards or apps to memorize card meanings.
  • Join tarot communities online or take a beginner class to learn tarot in a group setting.

Conclusion

Choosing your first tarot deck is a deeply personal and exciting journey. By trusting your intuition, considering the artwork, and starting with a beginner-friendly deck, you’ll set yourself up for a rewarding tarot practice. No matter which deck you choose, remember that the best tarot deck for you is the one that feels right in your hands and heart. Happy reading!

Introduction

In today’s fast-paced world, more people than ever are seeking guidance, clarity, and reassurance in their lives. Whether you’re searching for answers about love, career, or personal growth, online psychic readings provide an accessible and insightful way to connect with spiritual guidance. As the demand for virtual readings continues to rise, understanding how they work and what to expect can help you make the most of your experience.

Understanding Online Psychic Readings

What is a Psychic Reading?

A psychic reading is a spiritual session where an intuitive professional connects with your energy to provide insights, guidance, and answers to your questions. Psychics use different methods to tap into unseen energies, including clairvoyance (seeing), clairaudience (hearing), clairsentience (feeling), and other extrasensory abilities.

How Do Online Psychic Readings Work?

Psychic readings online function similarly to in-person sessions but are conducted through digital platforms. Whether via chat, phone, or video call, psychics use their gifts to tune into your energy remotely. The accuracy and depth of a reading depend not on physical presence but on the psychic’s ability to connect with you energetically. Many clients even find that readings conducted this way can be more relaxed, accurate, and focused, since they are taking place in the comfort of one’s own space.

Benefits of Online Psychic Readings

Accessibility

One of the biggest advantages of online psychic readings is that they are available to anyone, anywhere. Whether you live in a small town or a busy city, you can access top-rated psychics from around the world without leaving your home.

Convenience

Unlike in-person readings, psychic readings online allow you to schedule a session at a time that suits you best. You can receive guidance while lounging on your couch, sipping tea, or even on a lunch break. No commuting, no traffic—just direct access to intuitive support.

Anonymity and Privacy

For many, discussing personal matters with a psychic can feel vulnerable. Online readings offer a level of anonymity that allows clients to feel more comfortable opening up about their concerns. When you’re in your own familiar environment, it’s easier to let your guard down and receive messages with an open heart.

Types of Online Psychic Readings

Live Chat Readings

Live chat readings are perfect for those who prefer written communication. These readings allow you to type out your questions and receive real-time responses from a psychic. They are a great option for individuals who appreciate having a written record of their reading to reflect on later.

Phone Readings

Phone readings provide a more personal touch, allowing you to hear the psychic’s voice and experience their energy through tone and inflection. Many people find phone readings to be an intimate and direct way to receive spiritual guidance.

Video Call Readings

For those who want the closest experience to an in-person reading, video calls are the best option. Seeing your psychic face-to-face can enhance the connection and provide a richer, more interactive experience. These are particularly helpful when body language or facial expressions play a role in communication.

What to Expect During an Online Psychic Reading

Preparing for Your Reading

To get the most out of your psychic session, it helps to prepare mentally and emotionally. Here are a few tips:

  • Find a quiet, distraction-free space.
  • Set an intention for your reading.
  • Have a list of questions or topics you’d like clarity on.
  • Keep an open mind to receive messages that may not align with your expectations but hold deep significance.

Establishing a Connection with Your Psychic

Building a strong connection with your psychic is key to a successful reading. Engage with them openly, provide relevant information when needed, and allow the energy to flow naturally.

Asking the Right Questions

While psychics can provide general insights, asking specific questions can lead to more precise and meaningful answers. Instead of “Will I find love?” try “What can I do to attract a healthy relationship into my life?”

Receiving Guidance and Messages

Psychics deliver messages in various ways—through visions, intuitive impressions, messages from spirit guides, or interpretations of tools like tarot cards. Trust in the process and be open to unexpected insights. Many find that psychic readings online deliver equally, if not more, meaningful experiences than those done face-to-face.

Tips for a Successful Online Psychic Reading

Choose a Reputable Platform

Not all online psychic services are created equal. Do your research, read reviews, and select a platform with verified psychics and transparent pricing.

Trust Your Intuition

When selecting a psychic, trust your gut feeling. If a profile or energy doesn’t resonate with you, move on to someone who feels like the right fit.

Be Open-Minded

Spiritual guidance doesn’t always come in the form you expect. Be receptive to messages that may not directly answer your question but offer valuable insights into your journey.

Follow Up if Needed

Some readings raise more questions than they answer. If you need clarification, don’t hesitate to book a follow-up session or take time to reflect on the messages you received.

Conclusion

Online psychic readings are an incredible tool for gaining clarity, reassurance, and spiritual guidance from the comfort of your home. Whether you opt for a live chat, phone, or video reading, understanding how these sessions work can help you maximize their benefits. By preparing in advance, trusting the process, and choosing the right psychic for your needs, you can unlock deep insights that guide you toward your highest path.

If you’re curious about how psychic readings online can support your journey, take the first step today and connect with a trusted psychic to illuminate your path forward.

Introduction

In our busy, modern lives, it’s easy to overlook the subtle yet powerful ways that the spirit world tries to communicate with us. Many people report experiencing unusual sensations, dreams, or synchronicities that feel deeply meaningful—and often, these are signs from spirit. Understanding how to recognize and interpret these moments can open your heart and mind to a more connected, comforting, and spiritually guided life. This blog explores the different types of signs from spirit, how to validate them, and how you can become more aware of signs your loved ones are around you every day.

What Are Signs from Spirit?

Understanding Spiritual Communication

Signs from spirit are messages from the non-physical realm, often delivered by loved ones who have passed, spirit guides, or even the universe itself. These messages are intended to reassure, comfort, or guide you during times of uncertainty or emotional need.

These signs can be subtle or profound. Some people feel a sudden warmth, find feathers or coins in unexpected places, or repeatedly see certain animals or numbers. Others report hearing a favorite song at the perfect moment or sensing a familiar presence nearby. Regardless of how they show up, a sign from spirit is always meant to let you know: you are not alone.

Common Signs Your Loved Ones Are Around You

1. Feathers, Coins, and Other Objects

A feather on your path, a coin dated with significance, or a small object showing up repeatedly may be a loved one’s way of saying hello. These are some of the most classic signs from spirit and are often delivered in a way that catches your attention and makes you pause.

2. Dream Visitations

Vivid dreams that feel more real than usual could be visitations. In these dreams, you may have a conversation, hug, or even simply share space with a loved one. These are not ordinary dreams but are deeply emotional and stay with you upon waking.

3. Sudden Sensations or Fragrances

Have you ever smelled a familiar scent—like your grandmother’s perfume or your dad’s pipe smoke—without explanation? Or maybe you feel a warm touch, cool breeze, or tingling sensation on your skin. These are signs your loved ones are around you, reaching through the veil to make their presence known.

4. Animal Messengers

Animals are often used as messengers in the spirit world. A butterfly landing on your shoulder, a bird pecking at your window, or a specific animal repeatedly crossing your path may be a spirit sign. Trust your gut—if it feels significant, it probably is.

5. Numbers and Synchronicities

Seeing repeating numbers like 111, 444, or your loved one’s birthdate on a receipt, clock, or address is a common sign from spirit. These synchronicities often show up when you need encouragement or are on the right path.

How to Be More Open to Receiving Signs

Slow Down and Be Present

One of the most effective ways to notice signs from spirit is to slow down. When you’re caught up in the stress of daily life, it’s easy to miss the gentle nudges from the other side. Take time for mindfulness, meditation, or simply being in nature.

Ask for a Sign

Don’t be afraid to ask your spirit guides or departed loved ones for a specific sign. Be clear about what you’re asking for, and remain open to how and when it may appear. Spirit responds when we invite connection with genuine intention.

Keep a Spirit Sign Journal

Start a journal where you record experiences that feel like signs. Over time, you’ll start to notice patterns and become more attuned to the way your spirit team communicates with you.

Are Signs from Spirit Real or Just Coincidence?

Skepticism is natural. But the more you tune in and trust your intuition, the more undeniable these moments become. Many people find that a particular sign shows up consistently in times of grief, transition, or decision-making. These signs often come with a sense of peace, love, or “knowing.” When that happens, it’s far more than coincidence—it’s a connection.

When to Seek Support from a Psychic Medium

If you’ve been noticing signs from spirit and want to understand them more deeply, a session with a psychic medium can help. Mediums specialize in validating and interpreting messages from the spirit world, offering healing and clarity.

If you feel overwhelmed or unsure about what a sign from spirit means, a psychic medium can help you make sense of the messages and provide reassurance that your connection with your loved ones is real and enduring.

Conclusion

Signs your loved ones are around you can show up in a multitude of ways, from a feather on the sidewalk to a dream that brings you peace. When you remain open, present, and trusting, you’ll find that these signs become more frequent and more meaningful. Spirit is always communicating—we just have to learn how to listen.

Whether you’re new to spiritual experiences or deepening your intuitive practice, recognizing and embracing these signs is a powerful reminder that love never dies and we are always supported, guided, and surrounded by the unseen.

If you’re feeling called to explore these connections further, consider working with a trusted psychic medium to enhance your understanding and strengthen your connection to spirit.

Introduction

Children are naturally intuitive and often experience heightened psychic abilities before societal conditioning influences them. Many parents notice their child expressing uncanny insights, sensing energies, or interacting with unseen beings. Encouraging and supporting a child’s intuitive gifts can help them grow with confidence, balance, and a deeper connection to their inner wisdom. In this blog, we will explore psychic abilities in psychic children, signs to look for, and how to nurture their intuitive development in a healthy and supportive way.

Understanding Psychic Abilities in Children

What Are Psychic Abilities?

Psychic abilities refer to heightened intuitive perceptions that go beyond the five physical senses. These may include:

  • Clairvoyance (clear seeing): Visions or images of future events or unseen energies.
  • Clairaudience (clear hearing): Hearing messages or sounds that others cannot.
  • Clairsentience (clear feeling): Sensing emotions, energies, or the presence of spirits.
  • Claircognizance (clear knowing): An unexplainable inner knowing of events or truths.
  • Empathy: Deeply feeling the emotions and energies of others.

Why Are Children More Open Psychically?

Psychic children are naturally more receptive to intuitive and spiritual experiences because:

  • Their minds are less conditioned by logic and skepticism.
  • They have not yet been influenced by societal norms that dismiss psychic phenomena.
  • Their energetic fields are more open, allowing them to sense subtle vibrations.

Signs Your Child May Have Psychic Abilities

Many psychic children display signs of intuitive or spiritual awareness. Some common indicators include:

  • Talking about past lives or having memories they shouldn’t logically have.
  • Describing interactions with spirits, angels, or “imaginary friends” who feel very real.
  • Sensing when a loved one is in distress, even from afar.
  • Showing strong premonitions, such as predicting events before they happen.
  • Displaying deep empathy and absorbing emotions from those around them.
  • Experiencing vivid dreams or astral projections.
  • Reacting strongly to certain places or objects with unexplained emotions.

How to Support and Nurture Your Child’s Intuitive Development

Encourage Open Communication

Create a safe space where your child feels comfortable discussing their experiences without fear of judgment. Validate their feelings and let them know their psychic abilities are a gift, not something to be afraid of.

Teach Grounding and Protection Techniques

Psychically sensitive children can absorb a lot of external energy, which may be overwhelming. Teach them simple grounding exercises like:

  • Visualizing roots extending from their feet into the earth.
  • Practicing deep breathing and mindfulness.
  • Carrying protective crystals such as black tourmaline or amethyst.

Introduce Meditation and Mindfulness

Guided meditations can help psychic children manage their psychic abilities and maintain emotional balance. Simple practices like breath focus or imagining a bubble of light can enhance their intuitive development.

Normalize Their Experiences

Share age-appropriate stories about intuition and psychic abilities so they don’t feel isolated. Books, movies, and spiritual discussions can help reinforce that their gifts are natural and valuable.

Encourage Creative Outlets

Children with strong psychic abilities often thrive with creative expression. Activities like painting, journaling, music, and storytelling can help them process their insights.

Help Them Set Energetic Boundaries

Sensitive children need tools to protect their energy. Teach them to:

  • Visualize protective light around their body.
  • Use affirmations like “I am safe, and my energy is my own.”
  • Take quiet breaks from overstimulating environments.

When to Seek Guidance

If your child’s psychic abilities are causing fear or distress, consider consulting a spiritual mentor or intuitive coach who works with psychic children. They can provide support, practical tools, and insight into your child’s unique energy.

Conclusion

Psychic children are a beautiful reminder of our innate intuitive nature. By fostering their intuitive development with love, tools, and validation, parents can help them grow into empowered individuals who trust their inner knowing. Whether your child occasionally experiences spiritual nudges or regularly expresses deep intuitive insight, embracing their psychic abilities will help them thrive in a grounded, connected way.

Supporting your child’s psychic development can be a meaningful and transformative journey. If you’d like personalized guidance, consider booking a consultation to explore how to nurture their intuitive gifts in the best way possible.

If you are seeking clarity, guidance, or healing; finding the right psychic, medium, or healer can be a transformative experience. Here are some tips on how to search for the perfect match:

  • Define Your Needs: Take a moment to reflect on what you’re looking for. Are you interested in psychic readings, tarot readings, or energy healing? Do you need guidance on love and relationships, career decisions, or spiritual growth? Clarifying your intentions will help you narrow down your options.
  • Research Different Modalities: There are various types of psychic and healing services available, including clairvoyant services, astrology consultations, mediumship sessions, intuitive guidance, and various forms of energy healing. Take the time to research a few modalities to see what resonates best with you.
  • Read Reviews and Testimonials: Look for reviews and testimonials from previous clients to get an idea of the psychic or healer’s reputation and the quality of their services. Positive feedback can provide reassurance and help you feel more confident in your decision. Be sure to not only look at the number of reviews but what are some common compliments given about them. Does this align with your personality? 
  • Consider Convenience: Decide whether you prefer in-person sessions or online consultations. Many psychics offer online psychic readings or psychic readings by phone, providing flexibility and convenience, especially for those with busy schedules or limited mobility. Often, it is not necessary to have a reading in person. Video sessions and phone readings can be just as profound and so much more private and convenient. 
  • Location Matters: If you prefer in-person sessions, consider searching for “psychic readings near me” or “psychics in Sacramento” (insert your city). Local searches can help you find practitioners who are conveniently located and familiar with your area. You may be just having an online reading or phone session now but perhaps down the line you might enjoy attending a local event or retreat hosted by your practitioner. 
  • Trust Your Intuition: Ultimately, trust your instincts when choosing a psychic or healer. Pay attention to how you feel when reading their website or speaking with them. Do you feel a connection or resonance with their energy? Trusting your intuition can lead you to the right match for your needs.
  • Ask About Specializations: Some psychics and healers specialize in certain areas, such as love and relationship readings, career guidance readings, or tarot card interpretations. Inquire about their specialties to ensure they can address your specific concerns effectively.
  • Seek Psychic Insights: Look for a psychic or healer who offers more than just predictions or advice. Seek someone who provides psychic insights and guidance for personal growth and transformation. A holistic approach to healing can lead to deeper and more meaningful results.
  • Be Aware of Scams: People have been told they have a negative entity attachment or that someone is doing witchcraft on them and told they must pay hundreds or even thousands of dollars to have this energy removed or else they will be cursed forever. This is the oldest trick in the book, do not fall for it. Yes you may be feeling drained or down and depressed but they know that most people can relate to this and so they reframe what’s happening to you to make a sale. And when their exorcism or entity removal spell doesn’t work they will tell you it’s  because you have such a bad problem and they need to do it again and charge you more. You see where this is going? Please get a second opinion from someone fresh. 

Finding the right psychic or healer is a personal journey that requires careful consideration and intuition. By following these tips, you can embark on your search with confidence and openness to the transformative possibilities that lie ahead.

One of my favorite things about mediumship is how it can facilitate healing along a grief journey.

Mediumship has long been a modality people seek when they lose loved ones, especially too soon. It allows us to know that we are still connected to our loved ones and that there is life after death. 

Let’s talk quickly about what mediumship is in this context. Mediumship is when a medium or someone who has developed their ability, connects or communes with those who have passed on and relays information to a living loved one. Everyone has mediumistic ability but there are those who have developed their skills beyond their raw talent to be able to provide quality readings.

In these readings, it’s important to make sure that we see evidence of our loved ones such as who they were to us, traits and hobbies, maybe even birthday acknowledgements. This way we know that the connection is genuine. Without that piece, mediumship cannot be as effective or helpful.

Not only do we gain a sense of comfort from recognizing our loved ones through the evidence provided to us, but it can also give us a sense of closure and help us move toward acceptance of their passing.

We can know that we are still connected to them and they to us. It can also help to receive messages of love, forgiveness, reconciliation etc if we didn’t get the opportunity to establish that before their passing. This kind of session can be invaluable along someone’s healing journey. 

Being able to share who your loved one was in life is a gift in itself and can help provide closure and resolution if things were left unsaid. Sharing personal stories can make a world of difference for someone. For example, I have a client whose daughter has passed and she has had a few readings with me to connect with her. During our sessions, we talk about evidence of her daughter still knowing what’s going on in her mom’s life and being there to support her from the other side. She loves to tell stories of who she was; capturing the spirit and reliving those memories and moments with her are times when she feels connected to her daughter again; which is a joy any mother can understand. Those glimmers of reconnection reinforce the love and continued relationship that her and her daughter are able to have even after her passing. 

A mediumship session can also improve our own understanding of life after death and therefore make us feel that much more comfortable about death and what happens after. This can bring about a greater sense of peace in life. It can allow us to feel the interconnectedness of all life within the universe, as well as open our hearts to the presence of our loved ones on a daily basis.

Even our Spirit guides, Angels or higher beings can come closer and allow us to lean into that part of ourselves; Our intuition and the Divine guidance that comes through for us on a day-to-day basis. Therefore we’re able to live more consciously, authentically and compassionately.

There are a lot of reasons and varying situations that mediumship would provide closure or healing. Mediumship has shown me the diversity among individuals, while also revealing the underlying thread of connection that unites us all. And that is a beautiful, soulful experience.
